procedures.title: Online Application
procedures.description: A non-refundable application fee for the preferred program should be paid through Online Payment gateway Mode with the valid Credit Card / Debit Card or Net Banking facility.

procedures.title: Offline Application
procedures.description: Candidates can purchase a non-refundable application form from the Admissions Office, Nagarjuna Degree College, Yelahanka, Bengaluru.
